query.statement: SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, CURRENT_STATE_ID, STATE_CHANGED_AT, STATE_VERSION FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT HIST_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, SET_STATE, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY, REASON, SOURCE_TYPE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE_HISTORY WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT ALARM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_CODE, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_LEVEL, OCCURRED_AT, CLEARED_AT, ELAPSED_SECONDS FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@alarmLevel IS NULL OR ALARM_LEVEL = @alarmLevel) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS ALARM_COUNT, MAX(OCCURRED_AT) AS LAST_OCCURRED_AT FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM GROUP BY EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY ALARM_COUNT DESC, LAST_OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT OEE_DATE, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID, PLANNED_MINUTES, OPERATING_MINUTES, DOWNTIME_MINUTES, TOTAL_COUNT, GOOD_COUNT, DEFECT_COUNT, AVAILABILITY, PERFORMANCE, QUALITY, OEE, ROUND(AVAILABILITY * 100.0, 2) AS AVAILABILITY_PERCENT, ROUND(PERFORMANCE * 100.0, 2) AS PERFORMANCE_PERCENT, ROUND(QUALITY * 100.0, 2) AS QUALITY_PERCENT, ROUND(OEE * 100.0, 2) AS OEE_PERCENT FROM EST_OEE_SUMMARY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY OEE_DATE DESC, EQUIPMENT_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT LOSS_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS LOSS_COUNT, SUM(LOSS_MINUTES) AS TOTAL_MINUTES FROM EST_OEE_LOSS WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY LOSS_CATEGORY ORDER BY TOTAL_MINUTES DESC
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, SUM(LOSS_MINUTES) AS TOTAL_MINUTES, COUNT(*) AS LOSS_COUNT FROM EST_OEE_LOSS GROUP BY EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_MINUTES DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT INDEX_ID, INDEX_NAME, INDEX_CATEGORY, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_INDEX WHERE (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE = @isActive) ORDER BY INDEX_NAME

SELECT VALUE_ID, INDEX_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, OEE_DATE, SHIFT_ID, INDEX_VALUE FROM EST_EPT_INDEX_VALUE WHERE (@indexId IS NULL OR INDEX_ID = @indexId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY OEE_DATE DESC, INDEX_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT LAYOUT_ID, PLANT_ID, LAYOUT_NAME, AREA_ID, WIDTH, HEIGHT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_LAYOUT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@areaId IS NULL OR AREA_ID = @areaId) ORDER BY LAYOUT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, DESCRIPTION, CYCLE_TIME, DO_ALARM_INTERLOCK, DO_MCC, DO_SUMMARY, DO_TACT_TIME, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_EQUIPMENT_PROPERTY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT PLANT_ID, FROM_STATE_ID, TO_STATE_ID, ALLOW_FLAG, SET_STATE_ID, REQUIRE_REASON, VALID_STATE FROM EST_STATE_MATRIX WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, FROM_STATE_ID, TO_STATE_ID

SELECT EVENT_ID, PLANT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_EVENT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EVENT_NAME

SELECT MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID, SET_STATE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_STATE_ALARM_MAP WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID

SELECT MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, SET_STATE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_STATE_EVENT_MAP WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO EST_EPT_INDEX (INDEX_ID, INDEX_NAME, INDEX_CATEGORY, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@indexId, @indexName, @indexCategory, @unit, @description, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(INDEX_ID) DO UPDATE SET INDEX_NAME = excluded.INDEX_NAME, INDEX_CATEGORY = excluded.INDEX_CATEGORY, UNIT = excluded.UNIT, DESCRIPTION = excluded.DESCRIPTION, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO EST_EQUIPMENT_EVENT (EVENT_ID, PLANT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@eventId, @plantId, @eventName, @equipmentId, @eventType, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(EVENT_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = excluded.PLANT_ID, EVENT_NAME = excluded.EVENT_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID = excluded.EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE = excluded.EVENT_TYPE, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO EST_STATE_ALARM_MAP (MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID, SET_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@mapId, @plantId, @equipmentId, @alarmDefId, @setState, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(MAP_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = excluded.PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID = excluded.EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID = excluded.ALARM_DEF_ID, SET_STATE = excluded.SET_STATE, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO EST_STATE_EVENT_MAP (MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, SET_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@mapId, @plantId, @equipmentId, @eventId, @setState, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(MAP_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = excluded.PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID = excluded.EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID = excluded.EVENT_ID, SET_STATE = excluded.SET_STATE, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
DELETE FROM EST_EPT_INDEX WHERE INDEX_ID = @indexId
DELETE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = @eventId
DELETE FROM EST_STATE_ALARM_MAP WHERE MAP_ID = @mapId
DELETE FROM EST_STATE_EVENT_MAP WHERE MAP_ID = @mapId

SELECT TAKT_TARGET_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID, EFFECTIVE_FROM, EFFECTIVE_TO, REQUIRED_QTY, NET_AVAILABLE_SECONDS, IDEAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, QUANTITY_UOM, TIME_UOM, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_TAKT_TARGET WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@shiftId IS NULL OR SHIFT_ID = @shiftId) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE = @isActive) AND (@effectiveAt IS NULL OR (EFFECTIVE_FROM <= @effectiveAt AND (EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_TO >= @effectiveAt))) ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_FROM DESC, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID

SELECT TAKT_DATE, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID, REQUIRED_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, MEASURED_QTY, QUANTITY_UOM, NET_AVAILABLE_SECONDS, ACTUAL_RUN_SECONDS, TARGET_TAKT_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, IDEAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, ACTUAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, DEVIATION_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, DEVIATION_RATIO, CASE WHEN DEVIATION_RATIO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(DEVIATION_RATIO * 100.0, 2) END AS DEVIATION_PERCENT, AVAILABILITY_RATIO, ROUND(AVAILABILITY_RATIO * 100.0, 2) AS UTILIZATION_PERCENT, TIME_UOM, WINDOW_START_UTC, WINDOW_END_UTC FROM EST_TAKT_SUMMARY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@shiftId IS NULL OR SHIFT_ID = @shiftId) ORDER BY TAKT_DATE DESC, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID LIMIT 500

INSERT INTO EST_TAKT_TARGET (TAKT_TARGET_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID, EFFECTIVE_FROM, EFFECTIVE_TO, REQUIRED_QTY, NET_AVAILABLE_SECONDS, IDEAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, QUANTITY_UOM, TIME_UOM, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@taktTargetId, @plantId, @productId, @processId, @equipmentId, @shiftId, @effectiveFrom, @effectiveTo, @requiredQty, @netAvailableSeconds, @idealCycleSecondsPerUnit, @quantityUom, @timeUom, @description, 1, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(TAKT_TARGET_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID=excluded.PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID=excluded.PRODUCT_ID, PROCESS_ID=excluded.PROCESS_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID=excluded.EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID=excluded.SHIFT_ID, EFFECTIVE_FROM=excluded.EFFECTIVE_FROM, EFFECTIVE_TO=excluded.EFFECTIVE_TO, REQUIRED_QTY=excluded.REQUIRED_QTY, NET_AVAILABLE_SECONDS=excluded.NET_AVAILABLE_SECONDS, IDEAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT=excluded.IDEAL_CYCLE_SECONDS_PER_UNIT, QUANTITY_UOM=excluded.QUANTITY_UOM, TIME_UOM=excluded.TIME_UOM, DESCRIPTION=excluded.DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE=1, UPDATED_BY=excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT=excluded.UPDATED_AT
DELETE FROM EST_TAKT_TARGET WHERE TAKT_TARGET_ID = @taktTargetId

SELECT RUN_ID, RUN_TYPE, SCOPE_KEY, LOCAL_DATE, WINDOW_START_UTC, WINDOW_END_UTC, SHIFT_ID, PLANNED_MINUTES, ACTOR_ID, STATUS, AFFECTED_ROWS, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT FROM EST_OEE_AGGREGATION_RUN WHERE (@actorId IS NULL OR ACTOR_ID = @actorId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT OUTPUT_EVENT_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, OUTPUT_TYPE, CARRIER_ID, PROCESS_LOT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_VERSION, TOTAL_QTY, GOOD_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, UNIT, SOURCE, SOURCE_EVENT_ID, ACTOR_ID, CORRELATION_ID, OCCURRED_AT FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_OUTPUT_EVENT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@outputType IS NULL OR OUTPUT_TYPE = @outputType) AND (@carrierId IS NULL OR CARRIER_ID = @carrierId) AND (@from IS NULL OR OCCURRED_AT >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR OCCURRED_AT < @to) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT METER_ID, METER_NAME, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, UTILITY_TYPE, UNIT, FDC_PARAMETER_ID, READING_MODE, SCALE_FACTOR, COST_PER_UNIT, CARBON_PER_UNIT, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_UTILITY_METER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@utilityType IS NULL OR UTILITY_TYPE = @utilityType) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE = @isActive) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, UTILITY_TYPE, METER_ID

SELECT READING_ID, METER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_LOT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_VERSION, RAW_VALUE, NORMALIZED_VALUE, UNIT, SOURCE, SOURCE_EVENT_ID, QUALITY, RECORDED_AT, RECORDED_BY FROM EST_UTILITY_READING WHERE (@meterId IS NULL OR METER_ID = @meterId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@from IS NULL OR RECORDED_AT >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR RECORDED_AT < @to) ORDER BY RECORDED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT SUMMARY_ID, METER_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, START_READING, END_READING, CONSUMPTION, UNIT, COST_AMOUNT, CARBON_AMOUNT FROM EST_UTILITY_SUMMARY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@meterId IS NULL OR METER_ID = @meterId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@periodType IS NULL OR PERIOD_TYPE = @periodType) AND (@from IS NULL OR PERIOD_START >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR PERIOD_END <= @to) ORDER BY PERIOD_START DESC LIMIT 500
